verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents webhooks, an integrations marketplace ('connect with your favorite tools'), and a unified support inbox spanning Slack, Discord, and email, which covers chat and support connectivity. However, no specific evidence names CRM/sales tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) or Zendesk/Intercom-style two-way sync, only generic 'new integrations added constantly' language. missing for 10: explicit sales-tool integration list, named support-tool integrations beyond Slack/Discord/email, independent confirmation of integration depth.
